name: How should a homeowner prepare before drywall installation starts in their room addition?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before drywall installation starts in their room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation involves completing rough-in walk-throughs, confirming lighting layouts, and protecting adjacent living spaces from dust. Before drywall crews hang boards, ensure all electrical outlets, wall sconces, switches, and HVAC supplies are in their correct positions, as moving them post-drywall requires cutting and patching. Homeowners should also clear clear pathways through the home for moving 8-foot or 12-foot drywall sheets and confirm that containment barriers are in place to keep sanding dust from migrating into the main house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Confirm all electrical box and fixture locations with your contractor, verify framing inspections, and ensure clear walk paths and plastic dust barriers are set up.
